svg.title: Indian Ocean South Equatorial Undercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 5000 km. Declared 60-105 E March-May subsurface geographic reach. Approximate source longitude limits and west/east latitude context guide an OSW connecting path; not diagnosed whole-current endpoints. Surface SEC/SECC, equatorial EUC, ridge circulation loops and western/eastern extensions excluded. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate March-May subsurface studied reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 27 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Chen et al. (2022), sec. 2-3; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
